snippet.title: Father - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Here's your look at the unsettling world of Father in this trailer for the upcoming first-person psychological horror game about a family living in strict isolation under the oppressive rule of a father, blending religious themes and surreal storytelling. Father will be available on Steam.

#Father #Gaming #IGN
